Markets.title: Blackstone offers to sell up to 25% of India's Knowledge REIT for over $1 billion

Markets.summary: Sebi has banned Trafiksol ITS and its promoters from the securities market for one year. The company and its directors were also fined Rs 1.05 crore for financial disclosure violations and misusing SME IPO funds.
